Schedule of Assessments (FICTIONAL TRIAL FIXTURE-2L-001)

Treatment is given in 21-day cycles: ZX-4012 tablets once daily plus docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV on Day 1
(experimental arm), or docetaxel 75 mg/m2 IV on Day 1 alone (control arm). Day 1 = Cycle 1 Day 1.
Treatment continues until progression; the schedule below covers the first four cycles and the
end-of-treatment visit.

Visit 1 - Screening (Day -28 to Day -1; planned Day -21)
  Informed consent, medical history, physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods (hematology,
  chemistry, coagulation), urinalysis, 12-lead ECG, CT chest/abdomen/pelvis, MRI brain,
  quality-of-life questionnaire. About 5 hours on site.

Visit 2 - Cycle 1 Day 1 (Day 1)
  Physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods, docetaxel infusion (1 hour), ZX-4012 dispensed
  (experimental arm), pharmacokinetic samples pre-dose and at 1, 2 and 4 hours post-dose,
  quality-of-life questionnaire, adverse event review. About 7 hours on site.

Visit 3 - Cycle 1 Day 8 (Day 8, +/- 1 day)
  Vital signs, safety bloods, adverse event review. About 1.5 hours; bloods may be drawn at a
  local laboratory with a telephone check-in.

Visit 4 - Cycle 2 Day 1 (Day 22, +/- 3 days)
  Physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods, docetaxel infusion, ZX-4012 dispensed, adverse event
  review. About 4.5 hours on site.

Visit 5 - Cycle 3 Day 1 (Day 43, +/- 3 days)
  Physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods, docetaxel infusion, ZX-4012 dispensed,
  quality-of-life questionnaire, adverse event review. About 4.5 hours on site.

Visit 6 - Week 9 tumor imaging and optional biopsy (Day 57, +/- 7 days)
  CT chest/abdomen/pelvis (RECIST 1.1), vital signs. Optional research core-needle tumor biopsy
  for consenting patients, with 2 hours of observation afterwards. About 5 hours on site.

Visit 7 - Cycle 4 Day 1 (Day 64, +/- 3 days)
  Physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods, docetaxel infusion, ZX-4012 dispensed,
  quality-of-life questionnaire, adverse event review. About 4.5 hours on site.

Visit 8 - End of treatment (within 30 days of the last dose; planned Day 85)
  Physical exam, vital signs, safety bloods, CT chest/abdomen/pelvis, quality-of-life
  questionnaire, adverse event review. About 3 hours on site.
